title: Jovial Cheesy Australian Sweet Potato Hash
description: A delicious and earthy Australian dish featuring sweet potatoes, cheese, and coconut cream, perfect for a brunch mood, this recipe is low-calorie-friendly and air-fried to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced sweet potatoes, coconut cream, shredded cheese, diced onion, minced garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to the air fryer basket and cook for 15 minutes, shaking halfway through.
Remove the hash from the air fryer and stir in the olive oil.
Return the hash to the air fryer and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove the hash from the air fryer and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
